label: July 20–26, 2026
intro: Chiang Mai has moved into Cloud 11 — northern Thai potters, cooks, and makers are in residence through August 30. And Neo Land's final weekend is calling at ICONSIAM before it closes July 31.
weekday_note: Weekday visits to Sub-Zero are blissfully quiet — more ice, fewer wobbles.

activities.title: Toob North at theCOMMONS Cloud 11
activities.location: theCOMMONS Cloud 11, near Punnawithi BTS (Exit 6 skywalk)
activities.price: Free to browse; workshops priced per session
activities.why: Northern Thai potters, weavers, and food makers have taken over the space. Thor can watch live clay work, try a hands-on session, eat khao soi, and poke around handmade objects — ticks building & making all in one outing.
activities.tip: Weekday mornings are the quietest — makers are more chatty and hands-on when it's not packed. Weekend afternoons get lively.

activities.title: Roller Dome Emporium — Weekend Session
activities.location: Roller Dome, Emporium Shopping Mall, Sukhumvit Soi 24
activities.why: Southeast Asia's biggest indoor roller rink — perfect for Thor's rollerblading passion. There's a dedicated grass practice area for beginners before the main floor, and coaches are available. Air-conditioned.
activities.tip: Arrive at 10am to beat the lunch crowd. Helmets and knee pads included in rental.

activities.title: Neo Land at ICONSIAM — Last Weekend
activities.location: ICONSIAM, Charoen Nakhon Rd (Saphan Taksin BTS + Grab)
activities.why: Large-scale immersive art festival at the riverside mega-mall. This weekend (July 25–26) is one of the last chances before it closes. Pair with the riverside promenade for a bonus adventure.
activities.tip: Closes July 31 — this is your last full weekend. Morning visit to avoid evening crowds.

activities.title: Sub-Zero Ice Skating — Weekday Daytime
activities.location: Sub-Zero Ice Skate Club, Major Cineplex Sukhumvit (Ekkamai BTS, skywalk access)
activities.price: 100 THB kids / 200 THB adults + skate rental
activities.why: Weekday afternoons at Sub-Zero are nearly empty — Thor can work on ice balance without the weekend crush. Has both an Arena Rink for fun and an Academy Rink for coaching. Bring a light jacket!
activities.tip: A 60-min instructor session (900 THB) produces visible progress in one visit. Book at the rink or by phone.

activities.title: ClassBento Kids Ceramic Workshop
activities.date: Book any available slot at classbento.co.th
activities.location: Multiple Bangkok studios (central BKK / Thonglor area)
activities.price: Check classbento.co.th for current session prices
activities.why: Hands-on pinch pots, slabs, and coils for kids age 5+. Thor gets to build and decorate something from scratch — same clay energy as the pottery sessions he already loves.
activities.tip: Book directly at classbento.co.th/ceramic-workshop-for-kids. Weekend slots fill fast, book at least a week ahead.

activities.title: The Marvel Experience Thailand
activities.date: Ongoing — book any day via Klook
activities.time: Check Klook for current show times
activities.location: Mega Bangna parking lot (BTS On Nut + Grab, ~30 min)
activities.price: Discounted tickets on Klook (up to 45% off)
activities.why: Iron Man's Stark Mobile Lab, 4D stereoscopic dome, VR flight training, and character meet-and-greets with Iron Man, Thor the Avenger, Spider-Man, and Hulk. Built for exactly a 5-year-old Iron Man fan.
activities.tip: Book on Klook ahead for best price. Weekday mornings have the shortest queues. Allow 2 hours.
